scope: Official 3dmloader HookLibrary/UnhookLibrary (global WH_CBT) with the selected ZZMI runtime, LXMI-owned Proton prefixes and fixture images only
layout: images in <root>/bin, runtime in <root>/ZZMI (siblings); upstream verify_intended_target accepts any image directory contained in the DLL directory

prefix_a_non_fixture_processes.interpretation: Wine processes of prefix A mapped the module on CBT events and unloaded it each time (DllMain rejection); transient, D3DCOMPILER_47 from ZZMI is mapped with it

target_d3d11_resolved_before_window.upstream_mechanism: HookedDXGI.cpp CreateSwapChain -> DoubleBeepExit() -> ExitProcess(0xc0000135) (XXMI-Libs-Package v1.2.2 util.h)
target_d3d11_resolved_before_window.interpretation: When the original D3D11CreateDeviceAndSwapChain was resolved before ZZMI attached, the device bypassed the wrapper and ZZMI terminated the process deliberately

proton_override_finding: proton runinprefix skips setup_prefix, so DXVK native overrides are absent; HookLibrary then resolved ZZMI\d3d11.dll as Wine builtin d3d11 and returned 300. Fixture and ZZZ hook runner set WINEDLLOVERRIDES=d3d11,d3d10core,d3d9,dxgi,d3d12,d3d12core=n

earlier_runs.hook-isolation-638bacb48cc647e8feca983d1: proton run verb: fixture stdout not relayed; hook installed and rejected in other prefix processes; go timeout
earlier_runs.hook-isolation-791eae543602ebc4f7b4600d0: same results as final run, without per-child logs or repeats

conclusion: Under this Proton build the official global hook stayed within its wineserver/prefix, non-target processes rejected ZZMI, the target received ZZMI before device creation and the device was wrapped, and UnhookLibrary stopped further loads. Hook ordering matters: if the game resolves d3d11 before its first CBT event ZZMI aborts with 0xc0000135. This lifts the fixture-only isolation blocker; it does not establish ZZZ compatibility.
next_step: One consented ZZZ session with experiment.py run --arm-before-game --hook, after the user opens HoYoPlay from Steam.
